# Which roles answer a surface and its text?

Read this when your style plugin answers a fill, an ink or an overlay.

Every role on this page is a colour role, so no scale feeds it. An answer is a palette colour as a `{color.*}` alias or another colour role, as [`style-kernel.md`](../../style-kernel.md#the-two-rules-that-decide-everything-else) says.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

| role | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--fill-field` | color | none | none |
| `--fill-page` | color | none | none |
| `--fill-surface` | color | none | none |
| `--fill-surface-floating` | color | none | none |
| `--fill-surface-raised` | color | none | none |
| `--fill-surface-sunken` | color | none | none |
| `--fill-track` | color | none | none |
| `--ink-action` | color | none | `{color.base-content}` |
| `--ink-body` | color | none | none |
| `--ink-eyebrow` | color | none | none |
| `--ink-figure` | color | none | `{color.base-content}` |
| `--ink-heading` | color | none | none |
| `--ink-key` | color | none | `{ink-muted}` |
| `--ink-link` | color | none | `{ink-body}` |
| `--ink-muted` | color | none | none |
| `--overlay-media` | color | none | none |
